employees.evidence: people at Facebook are builders at heart

community.evidence: Facebook’s mission is to give people the power to build community and bring the world closer together

innovation.evidence: Our global teams are constantly iterating, solving problems, and working together

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, mission-led framing centred on community and connection, stated in absolute terms without hedging. Most text is factual history, statistics and leadership bios, which code as description. The culture paragraph uses warm, collective wording ('builders at heart'). The page addresses users and society before employees or shareholders, with no sustainability, safety or governance commitments.
